title: Psalm 56 (Septuagint) = Psalm 57 (KJV)
description: Psalm 56 in the Septuagint numbering (Psalm 57 in the KJV). Both the manuscript page scan AND the Greek text are taken directly from Codex Sinaiticus (4th century AD) via the Codex Sinaiticus Project (codexsinaiticus.org). The Greek transcription preserves the actual uncial forms, lunate sigma, nomina sacra abbreviations, and lectional marks of the manuscript. Library folio: 102. English translation verbatim from the King James Version (1611, public domain) via bible-api.com.
introduction:
This entry meets the strict three-criteria standard of the Theosis Library, with the manuscript text drawn directly from the same source as the scan:

  1. Manuscript scan: The actual folio of Codex Sinaiticus containing this passage, from the Codex Sinaiticus Project (codexsinaiticus.org). Library folio reference: 102.
  2. Original text: The verbatim transcription of the Sinaiticus manuscript from the Codex Sinaiticus Project, preserving uncial forms, lunate sigma, nomina sacra (e.g. ⟨θϲ⟩ = θεός), and scribal marks. Nomina sacra are shown in angle brackets to indicate the manuscript's sacred-name abbreviations.
  3. English translation: The King James Version (1611), retrieved verbatim from the public-domain bible-api.com endpoint.

Numbering: Codex Sinaiticus follows the Septuagint Psalter, in which this is Psalm 56. In the Hebrew and King James numbering the same psalm is Psalm 57. Greek verse numbers follow the Septuagint, which counts the superscription as verse 1; English verse numbers follow the KJV, so they run 1 behind the Greek. The Greek and English in each section are the same words of the same psalm.

translation.original_text: <sup>1</sup>ειϲ το τελοϲ μη διαφθειρηϲ δαυειδ ειϲ ϲτηλογραφιαν εν τω αυτον αποδιδραϲκειν απο προϲωπου ϲαουλ ειϲ το ϲπηλαιον <sup>2</sup>ελεηϲον με ο θϲ ελεηϲον με οτι επι ϲοι πεποιθεν η ψυχην μου και εν τη ϲκια των πτερυγων ϲου ελπιω εωϲ ου παρελθη η ανομια <sup>3</sup>κεκραξομαι προϲ τον θν τον υψιϲτο τον θν τον ευεργετηϲαντα με <sup>4</sup>εξαπεϲτειλεν εξ ουρανου και εϲωϲεν με εδωκεν ειϲ ονειδοϲ του καταπατουνταϲ με διαψαλμα εξαπεϲτειλεν ο θϲ το ελεοϲ αυτου κ(αι) την αληθειαν αυτου <sup>5</sup>και ερρυϲατο την ψυχην μου εκ μεϲου ϲκυμνων εκοιμηθην τεταραγμενοϲ υιοι ανθρωπων οι οδοντεϲ αυτων οπλον και βελη και η γλωϲϲα αυτων μαχαιρα οξεια
translation.text:
<sup>1</sup>Be merciful unto me, O God, be merciful unto me: for my soul trusteth in thee: yea, in the shadow of thy wings will I make my refuge, until
these
 calamities be overpast. <sup>2</sup>I will cry unto God most high; unto God that performeth
all things
 for me. <sup>3</sup>He shall send from heaven, and save
from the reproach of him that would swallow me up. Selah. God shall send forth his mercy and his truth. <sup>4</sup>My soul
is among lions:
and I lie
even among
 them that are set on fire,
even the sons of men, whose teeth
are spears and arrows, and their tongue a sharp sword.

translation.original_text: <sup>6</sup>υψωθητι επι τουϲ ουρανουϲ ο θϲ και επι παϲαν την γην η δοξα ϲου <sup>7</sup>πακιδαϲ ητοιμαϲαν την ψυχην μου και κατεκαμψαν την ψυχην μου ωρυξαν προ προϲωπου μου βοθρον και ενεπεϲαν ειϲ αυτον διαψαλμα <sup>8</sup>ετοιμη η καρδια μου ο θϲ ετοιμη η καρδια μου αϲομαι και ψαλω ϲοι εν τη δοξη μου <sup>9</sup>εξεγερθητι η δοξα μου εξεγερθητι ψαλτηριον και κιθαρα εξεγερθηϲομαι ορθρου <sup>10</sup>εξομολογηϲομαι ϲοι εν λαοιϲ κε ψαλω ϲοι εν εθνεϲιν
translation.text:
<sup>5</sup>Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens;
let thy glory
be above all the earth. <sup>6</sup>They have prepared a net for my steps; my soul is bowed down: they have digged a pit before me, into the midst whereof they are fallen
themselves.
 Selah. <sup>7</sup>My heart is fixed, O God, my heart is fixed: I will sing and give praise. <sup>8</sup>Awake up, my glory; awake, psaltery and harp: I
myself will awake early. <sup>9</sup>I will praise thee, O Lord, among the people: I will sing unto thee among the nations.

translation.original_text: <sup>11</sup>οτι εμεγαλυνθη εωϲ των ουρανων το ελεοϲ ϲου και η αληθεια ϲου εωϲ των νεφελων <sup>12</sup>ϋψωθητι επι τουϲ ουρανουϲ ο θϲ και επι παϲαν την γην η δοξα ϲου
translation.text:
<sup>10</sup>For thy mercy is great unto the heavens, and thy truth unto the clouds. <sup>11</sup>Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens:
let thy glory
be above all the earth.
